name: Bauhaus Geometric
description: Bauhaus geometry: square controls and cards with a bar of accent color across the foot of each, 2px ink outlines, heavy 4px ink bars for rules, circular media and badges, no shadow, a strong mechanical in-out curve with a press that squares down, and a geometric pattern on the shared surfaces.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's bauhaus recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: A decorative gradient texture sits behind surfaces.
Its texture sits in the surfaces' padding, at their edges, not across them as the prototype's does, so no text is drawn over it.

tokens.texture: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 12%, transparent) 0 20px, transparent 20px), radial-gradient(circle at 75% 100%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-information) 10%, transparent) 0 14px, transparent 15px)
